editorial.blurb: Flaco's Tacos brings lively outdoor charm and fresh, well-executed Mexican fare to a beloved neighborhood spot beneath the CTA tracks.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab a seat outside on a warm evening when the weather cooperates—the covered patio under the CTA creates a uniquely cozy, buzzing atmosphere that's half the experience.

topDishes.note: Perfectly prepared, one of the best ever
Freshly fried, classic, crispy and buttery
